text: Originally from another province, I went to Chiang Mai for 7 days during the New Year holiday. My sibling got sick, so we used their services on January 1st, 2026, because clinics in Chiang Mai were closed. Dr. Teunjit provided excellent treatment. They did blood tests because my sibling had a fever since December 29th, 2025, and also performed a nasal swab to check for infection. The doctor gave good advice, the service was excellent, and the price wasn't as expensive as I thought.
author_name: สุกัญญา คำพันธ์

text:
#McCormickHospital ⛑️
They have a new #PediatricClinic 👶 building now!
Brand new, sparkling white, clean and beautiful.
Sweet pastel-colored chairs.

It's a new building located at the back of the hospital.
2 floors. The ground floor is for examination rooms 💉
The second floor is for dispensing medication and payment 💊
There's a small garden next to it 🪴🌳
There's parking in front and in the lot behind the building.

Convenient and efficient, well-organized, short waiting times.
Doctors, nurses, and staff provide good service.
Treatment costs are not expensive: Doctor 250, Nurse 125, Outpatient 50.
I went to pick up flu medication, 1,450.
Bringing Nong Baipor to the doctor.
